body: Audit B-90 (install.sh read 6 Nov 2026, not run): the installer strips $, quotes, backquotes, # and backslashes from the server's name before it writes the settings file, but writes ENCORE_MUSIC_DIR=$MUSIC_DIR exactly as typed. Docker Compose reads that .env: a $ in a path is taken for a variable and a # after a space starts a comment, so a folder like '/srv/My Music #2' or '/mnt/$music' is cut or emptied and the music server starts on another folder with nothing in it. A stranger types whatever their folder is called. Quote the value the way Compose reads it (single quotes, refusing a path with a single quote) or refuse such a path with a sentence, and run the same check in 'encore' when the folder is changed. Add a case to this item's install walk: a music folder with a space and a #. Register: docs/tasks/AUDIT-BUILT-2026-11-05.md B-90.
